project.title: High throughput 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing of laboratory on-site wastewater systems, sterile sand material
project.description: "Blank" sand (no established microbial community) was dosed with residential wastewater for 60 days. Experimental treatments were characterized by 16S gene amplicon high throughput sequencing (2x300bp Illumina). Samples were collected in October 2019.
project.center_name: Center for Clean Water Technology, NY, USA
